craft_notes: Sthāyin: kiss-wonder. cummake kept. Close: host. Rejected: explaining the kiss — killed; 'yogi' for naraḥ — killed.

lines: Who minds it for a moment — in the kiss, navel-sealed —
he binds then all, and the mantra-seal-host.
l4.sanskrit_cite: muhūrta smarate yastu cummakenābhimudritaḥ saṃbadhnāti tadā sarvaṃ mantramudrāgaṇaṃ naraḥ |

reads_against.argmap: Remembering a moment in kiss, navel-sealed, he binds then all — body and mantra-host.
c1_essence: Remembered a moment in kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host.
